package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
)

func run(items []string, mode int) (string, error) {
	out := ""
	for _, it := range items {
		if err := check(it); err != nil {
			if mode == 1 {
				err = nil
			} else if mode == 2 {
				err = nil
			} else {
				return "", err
			}
		}
		out += fmt.Sprintf("%s,", it)
	}
	switch mode {
	case 1:
		return out, nil
	case 2:
		return out, nil
	case 3:
		return out, errors.New("mode 3")
	}
	return out, nil
}

func check(s string) error {
	if len(s) == 0 {
		return errors.New("empty")
	}
	return nil
}
